   \( \bar{x}= \dfrac{100+95+85+90+88+92}{6}=91.\overline{66}\)

2. **Squared deviations from the mean**  

| Score | Deviation (\(x-\bar x\)) | Squared deviation |
|------|--------------------------|-------------------|

| 85   | –6.67                    | 44.45             |
| 90   | –1.67                    | 2.78              |

*Sum of squared deviations*:  
\(S_{\!sq}=69.44+11.11+44.45+2.78+13.44+0.11=141.33\)

3. **Population variance** (divide by *N*, here 6):  
\(\sigma^{2}= \dfrac{141.33}{6}=23.56\)

4. **Standard deviation** (square root of variance):  
\(\displaystyle\sigma=\sqrt{23.56}\approx 4.86\)
